comments.body_html:
This is a bug in the quest definition. You have to adjust an entry in mods\Virtual’s Custom Quest Loader\database\quests\VCQM.json.

On line 1131 “laboratory” must be written with a small L, then the quest will work.

“VCQM_9”: { “QuestName”: “Exceptional Marksman: Part 4”, “_id”: “VCQM_9”, “canShowNotificationsInGame”: true, “changeQuestMessageText”: “VCQM_9 changeQuestMessageText”, “conditions”: { “AvailableForFinish”: [ { “_parent”: “CounterCreator”, “_props”: { “counter”: { “id”: “VCQM_9_AFF_0_0”, “conditions”: [ { “_parent”: “Kills”, “_props”: { “target”: “AnyPmc”, “compareMethod”: “>=”, “value”: “1”, “id”: “VCQM_9_AFF_0_1”, “weapon”: [ “5c46fbd72e2216398b5a8c9c” ] } }, { “_parent”: “Location”, “_props”: { “target”: [ “Laboratory” // must be “laboratory” with an lowercase L ], “id”: “VCQM_9_AFF_0_2” } } ] }, “id”: “VCQM_9_AFF_0”, “index”: 0, “parentId”: “”, “oneSessionOnly”: false, “dynamicLocale”: false, “type”: “Elimination”, “doNotResetIfCounterCompleted”: false, “value”: “10”, “visibilityConditions”: [] }, “dynamicLocale”: false } ]
